content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

The implementation of retirement at 63 is no longer socially sustainable, as the population in Germany has, viewed demographically, a disproportionate number of old people, and constantly declining birth rates are being recorded. Admittedly the number of immigrants is constantly rising in Germany, but without sufficient, well-qualified junior employees there is hardly a possibility for adequate pension financing.
What argument components exists in sentence " Admittedly the number of immigrants is constantly rising in Germany, but without sufficient, well-qualified junior employees there is hardly a possibility for adequate pension financing" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.

<opp>Admittedly the number of immigrants is constantly rising in Germany,</opp> <pro>but without sufficient, well-qualified junior employees there is hardly a possibility for adequate pension financing</pro>
